newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as Thai price weakens.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as Thai price weakens.

text.p: Signs of weakening in benchmark Thai rice price plus the presence of producer selling pressed CBOT rice futures to a lower close, traders said.
"Farmers have been big sellers and the Thai market is at $320.00 (per tonne) or lower," a trader said. The Thai price was down from the $320.00 to $330.00 per ton mark recently traded.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, below Tuesday's tally of 660.
Rice closed two to four cents lower, with January down 3-1/2 cents at $10.52 per cwt.
